Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of GS.
Our gross margin expanded by 176 basis points to 62.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1451 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 20% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1451 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 20% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
